speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: If I am not to come, you can at least hear me say it as they say it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are not to come. You may say two lines, and then you are back at the shop.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: With loues light wings did I orepearch these walls—

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: He gallops. Hamnet had the wings on Thursday, from the floor, and this one has caught the pace.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wednesday was a name, on the floor. Today is a line, and you are in the orchard. Wait. She speaks. You are not in until she has finished being alone.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: O Romeo, Romeo, wherfore art thou Romeo?

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: Now?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Now. And quieter. The orchard can hear you from the lane, and the lane is not the yard.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: With loues light wings. There. I waited.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You waited once. Do it until you can do it when nobody is counting.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: Nick is not much older, and he is already in London.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nick is bound to Heminges, and he has been a queen since he was eleven. You are not bound. Nobody has asked for you. Read the cues aloud. Keep at the work you have.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: Reading aloud is a small beginning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the beginning you have. The rest of the argument can wait for the table. Here you have two cues.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Don't give him the girl. She is too quick, and he would make her quicker.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has the boy, and only the entrance. The rest of her stays on the sheet.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: If I read it every day until you come again—

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you will read better, and you will still be here. Two lines. The shop. That is the bargain in the orchard.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: He'll do the wings at supper, in front of Grandfather, if you don't take the page back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The page stays in the house. Edmund, give it here. You have it in your ear now, which is where a cue belongs.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I'll read it aloud. I'll stay. I am not agreeing that I like it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Read it in the morning, when the shop is quiet, and not at the table to show Grandfather you can.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: I can say it without an audience. That is the part I am agreeing to.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Then say it once more, under the line, and give him the page.

speaker: edmund_shakespeare
text: With loues light wings. There. The page is yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not ask you to like it. I asked you to read, and to keep at the work.
